# dtcloud_vm_history_entry (Data Source)

Reads one virtual machine history entry in full.

The list endpoint leaves out `status`; this is the only way to get it. It is a separate data source
rather than the list reading every entry in full, which would cost one call per entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The most recent entry from dtcloud_vm_history, read in full to get its status.
data "dtcloud_vm_history_entry" "latest" {
  vm_id      = dtcloud_vm.web.id
  history_id = data.dtcloud_vm_history.web.entries[0].id
}

output "latest_status" {
  value = data.dtcloud_vm_history_entry.latest.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `history_id` (String) ID of the entry, from dtcloud_vm_history.
- `vm_id` (String) ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `activity` (String) What was done.
- `date_and_time` (String) When it happened.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `initiator` (String) Who or what did it.
- `status` (String) Outcome of the action. Reported only by this endpoint, not by the list.

## Behaviour worth knowing

~> The same warning as `dtcloud_vm_history` applies: this is an event log, and its content moves.
Keep it out of resource arguments.
